opening.text: I've been having fevers that come and go for about a month, peaking at 39.6 °C, and I've been having night sweats. I've lost 7 kg over the past two months and have a mild cough. I work in a blood bank and donate plasma frequently. Recently I did farm work in my home region along the Yangtze River, so I was in contact with soil.
